title: Place nontrivial job scripts in the repository scripts directory
summary: When an automation job requires a substantial standalone script, create or maintain that script as a file under the verified local project's scripts/ directory rather than implementing it inside the job YAML.
statement: When an automation job requires a substantial standalone script, create or maintain that script as a file under the verified local project's scripts/ directory rather than implementing it inside the job YAML.

conditions: Job targets an existing explicitly authorized local repository.
exceptions: Does not authorize changing unrelated or substitute repositories.
